title: Effects of Remote Ischemic Preconditioning on Restenosis Post Lower Limb Revascularization Angioplasty
brief_summary: The investigators will established relation between restenosis and inflammatory response to shearing stress caused by angioplasty suggest that any mechanism that affect inflammatory response can consequently affect the restenosis rate. There is accumulated evidence that remote ischemic precondition has modifying suppressive effect on inflammatory response and the investigators hypothesized that RIPC may lead to reduction in post angioplasty restenosis rate.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion criteria

1\. Patients planned for lower limb Angioplasty

Exclusion criteria

1. Known upper limb PVD
2. Previous history of upper limb deep vein thrombosis
3. Patients on glibenclamide or nicorandil- May affect RIPC
4. Raynaud's Disease
5. Intra operative decision to use graft - will be documented
